w10_T4_000112: A vending machine route starts the week with 202 dollars in coins collected from the last round, which the driver always converts to cents in his head — 20,200 of them, to be exact. A restock stop adds 75 more dollars in coins from a busy machine downtown. At the next stop, 164 dollars is removed to refill the machine's change dispenser. A third stop's haul brings the total to 4 times what remained after the refill. A bonus route he wasn't expecting to run adds 48 more dollars to his bag. A big office-building stop brings the bag's total to 2 times what it had grown to. Finally, the day's last stop, a shopping mall food court, brings the total to 7 times what it had reached. How much money is in the driver's coin bag by the end of the route?
w10_T4_000118: In the morning, a toy drive bin at the community center already holds 167 toys collected the day before. A dozen volunteers show up to help sort donations, though that headcount has nothing to do with how many toys come in. By midday, a school group drops off 73 more toys. Later that afternoon, a nearby daycare adds 33 more toys to the bin. In the early evening, a local business donates 67 toys during a special drive. Right before the center closes for the night, a matching-donation pledge brings the bin's total to 6 times what it had reached. How many toys are in the bin by closing time?
w10_T4_000128: Sofia has practiced piano for 25 minutes so far this week, which comes out to exactly 1,500 seconds if you convert it. A weekend practice marathon brings her total time to 8 times what it was. She then practices for 13 more minutes on Monday after school. On Tuesday, she adds another 4 minutes before dinner. On Wednesday, a full extra session adds 74 more minutes to her total. How many minutes has Sofia practiced piano this week?
w10_T4_000145: A chess club's tournament ladder starts the season with 64 points assigned to its top player, Wei. He loses 56 points after a tough defeat in round one. Wei earns 7 points back after a strong win in round two. A dozen members joined the club at the start of the season, though that number plays no role in the point totals. He loses 3 more points after a controversial draw is scored against him. In round four, he gains 13 points from a well-played endgame. A final tournament bonus adds 38 more points to his ladder score. How many points does Wei have on the ladder now?
w10_T4_000153: An aquarium store's largest tank holds 136 guppies at the start of the month. A new shipment adds 3 more guppies that were quarantined separately before release. A second shipment brings in 68 more guppies from a breeder upstate. A third delivery adds 40 more guppies just before the weekend sale. The store's second tank, meanwhile, houses 220 goldfish, completely separate from the guppy count. A breeding boom over the following weeks brings the guppy population to 3 times what it had grown to. Finally, 50 more guppies are added after a rescue shipment from a closing pet store. How many guppies are in the tank now?
w10_T4_000156: In the morning, twins Ella and her brother Sam open their lemonade stand with 104 dollars in the cash box from last week's sales, which they always mentally convert to cents — 10,400 of them. By midday, a big group of tourists brings the cash box to 4 times what it was. In the early afternoon, 118 dollars is spent restocking lemons, sugar, and cups for the rest of the summer. Sam's friend Deshawn, who runs a competing stand across the park, says his own box only has 60 dollars in it, far less than the twins' total. By late afternoon, a fundraiser tie-in brings the cash box to 6 times what remained after restocking. That evening, the money is split evenly into 3 equal shares between Ella, Sam, and their cousin, and the story follows just Ella's share from here. A final round of evening sales adds 69 more dollars to Ella's share. Right before closing, a matching donation from their uncle brings Ella's share to 7 times what it had grown to. How much money is in Ella's share of the cash box now?
w10_T4_000158: A phone accessory shop starts the month with 211 cases in the stockroom. A bulk order delivery brings the stockroom's count to 6 times what it was. A big weekend sale then moves 830 cases out to customers. A wholesale order to a smaller retailer takes another 126 cases off the shelves. A second bulk shipment brings the remaining stock to 6 times what it had fallen to. A final clearance sale at the end of the month sells off 917 cases. How many cases are left in the stockroom?
w10_T4_000160: In the morning, a beekeeper counts 28 bees in a newly split hive. By midday, 7 bees are lost after a brief cold snap. In the early afternoon, the queen's egg-laying surge brings the hive's population to 7 times what remained. By late afternoon, an unusually warm spell brings the population to 8 times what it had grown to. By evening, a swarm merges into the hive, bringing its population to 8 times what it was. How many bees are in the hive by evening?
w10_T4_000165: Kayla has 66 dollars saved for a new skateboard. She spends 20 dollars on new wheels for her old board first. A birthday card from her aunt adds 4 more dollars to her savings. She then spends 25 dollars on safety pads at the sports store. Her friend Zoe, who has been saving separately, has 90 dollars set aside, more than what Kayla started the week with. The sports store, coincidentally, restocked a dozen new skateboard models that same weekend. Kayla earns 35 more dollars doing yard work over the weekend. A final store discount effectively brings her savings to 7 times what she had. How much money does Kayla have saved now?
w10_T4_000175: A coin collector has 140 rare coins in his display case at the start of spring. A quick trade at a local shop adds 4 more coins to the case. A dozen fellow collectors show up to a swap meet that weekend, though that number has nothing to do with his coin count. A big auction win brings his collection to 8 times what it was. He then splits his collection evenly across 4 identical display cases, and the story follows just one of those cases from here on. A final donation from a retiring collector brings that case's coins to 9 times what it held. How many coins are in that one display case now?
w10_T4_000176: A hardware factory's storage bin holds 122 boxes of screws at the start of the shift. A morning production run adds 35 more boxes. A second run adds 65 more boxes shortly after. An automated packing surge brings the bin's total to 8 times what it had grown to. The factory's break room, meanwhile, ordered 200 sandwiches for the week's shifts, unrelated to the screw count. A late afternoon shipment adds 48 more boxes to the bin. A final rush order from a hardware chain brings the bin's total to 5 times what it had reached, all logged in a warehouse system that records weights in kilograms and converts them to pounds for the shipping label. How many boxes of screws are in the bin now?
w10_T4_000178: In the morning, a lemonade stand's cash box has 240 cents in it (that's 2 dollars and 40 cents) left over from the day before. By midday, the stand earns 52 more cents from early customers. In the early afternoon, 266 cents is spent restocking cups and lemons. By late afternoon, 18 more cents is spent on ice from the corner store. That evening, the two kids running the stand split what's left exactly in half between them. How many cents does one of the kids end up with?
w10_T4_000190: Marcus has read 72 pages of his summer reading book by Monday. On Tuesday, he reads 70 more pages during a long car ride. On Wednesday, he reads 47 more pages before bed. A dozen kids in his class are doing the same reading challenge, though that number has nothing to do with his own page count. On Thursday, he reads 65 more pages during a rainy afternoon. On Friday, he skips 30 pages of an appendix section he doesn't need for his book report. A weekend re-reading of key chapters brings his effective page count to 6 times what it had been. How many pages has Marcus read now?
w10_T4_000193: A concert venue starts ticket sales with 105 tickets already reserved for VIP guests. A presale event brings that number to 7 times what it was. A general sale then brings the reserved count to 8 times what it had grown to. A processing error causes 5,128 of those tickets to be released back into general inventory by mistake. The remaining reserved tickets are then split evenly between the venue's two VIP entrances, and the story follows just one entrance's list. Finally, 64 names are removed from that entrance's list after a late round of cancellations that took 55 minutes, just under an hour, to fully process. How many names remain on that one entrance's list?
w10_T4_000195: In the morning, a food bank has 181 canned goods on its shelves. By midday, a school donation drive adds 74 more cans. In the early afternoon, a grocery store adds 28 more cans from its overstock. By late afternoon, a community-wide donation event brings the shelves to 6 times what they had grown to. That evening, a matching corporate pledge triples the shelves' contents once more. Right before closing, 658 cans are distributed to families in need. How many cans remain on the shelves after distribution?
w10_T4_000198: A break-room snack fund starts the month with 114 dollars in it, which the office manager likes to say is 11,400 cents when explaining the math to new hires. A payday contribution adds 64 more dollars from everyone chipping in. A bonus matching program brings the fund's total to 4 times what it had grown to. Coworker Priya then adds 21 more dollars from a bake sale she ran. Her officemate Doug, who never contributes much, has put in only a dozen dollars total this whole year, a fact Priya brings up often. The fund then spends 695 dollars restocking the vending machine and coffee station for the quarter. A final office party expense removes 10 more dollars from the fund. How much money is left in the snack fund?
w10_T4_000201: A grain silo starts harvest season with 218 bushels of wheat stored inside. A record harvest brings the silo's contents to 5 times what it was. A neighboring farm delivers 48 more bushels to be stored temporarily. A large order for a flour mill removes 275 bushels. A second mill order takes another 649 bushels. A final small order for a local bakery removes 71 more bushels. How many bushels of wheat are left in the silo?
w10_T4_000207: In the morning, a construction site has 202 bricks stacked and ready, delivered the night before in a shipment weighing just over 4 tons, or roughly 8,000 pounds. By midday, a bulk delivery brings the site's brick count to 5 times what it was. In the early afternoon, 199 bricks are used to finish a section of the retaining wall. By late afternoon, 32 more bricks arrive from a supplier correcting an earlier shortage. By evening, a final rush delivery for tomorrow's work brings the count to 9 times what it had grown to. How many bricks are on site by the end of the day?
w10_T4_000211: A lab technician starts an experiment with 37 bacteria cells in a petri dish, recorded at exactly 9:00 in the morning. After the first growth cycle, which takes 90 minutes — an hour and a half — the population grows to 4 times what it was. After a second growth cycle, the population grows to 2 times its size again. A third cycle brings the population to 6 times what it had reached. A fourth cycle brings it to 8 times its size. A contamination event forces the technician to add 20 cells from a backup culture to keep the experiment viable. A final growth cycle before the experiment ends brings the population to 2 times what it had grown to. How many bacteria cells are in the dish at the end of the experiment?
w10_T4_000223: In the morning, a parking garage has 124 cars parked inside. By midday, 51 cars leave as their owners head to lunch meetings downtown. In the early afternoon, a nearby stadium event brings the garage's count to 2 times what remained. By late afternoon, a second wave of event traffic brings the count to 6 times what it had grown to. By evening, a final rush of concertgoers brings the garage's count to 4 times what it was. How many cars are in the garage by evening?
w10_T4_000226: In the morning, a farmer's market stall has 85 dollars in its cash box, which the vendor, Rosa, always pictures as 8,500 cents. By midday, a busy rush brings the box's total to 2 times what it was. In the early afternoon, a second rush brings it to 3 times what it had grown to. Rosa's stall neighbor, Tomas, mentions his own box only reached 200 dollars today, well behind Rosa's total. By late afternoon, Rosa splits her earnings evenly into 3 shares to pay her two part-time helpers and herself, and the story follows just her own share from here. That evening, she spends 6 dollars on parking before heading home. How much money does Rosa have left from her share?
w10_T4_000228: Owen has 210 points in his arcade racing game save file. He loses 21 points after crashing during a tricky level. A speed-bonus multiplier then brings his score to 7 times what remained. His rival, Zeke, brags that his own best score is only a dozen points higher than what Owen started with today, though Zeke rarely bothers to check his math. Owen then earns 30 more points from a perfect lap bonus. A double-event weekend brings his score to 8 times what it had grown to. A final leaderboard bonus brings his score to 5 times what it was. How many points does Owen have now?
w10_T4_000239: Derek owns 138 comic books at the start of the year. A convention haul brings his collection to 4 times what it was. A follow-up online buying spree brings it to 4 times what it had grown to. A friend gifts him 68 more comics from an old collection being cleared out. He then splits his collection evenly into 2 equal piles, keeping only one pile for himself. How many comic books does Derek have now?
w10_T4_000245: A classroom has 232 marbles in a shared jar at the start of the term. The teacher splits them evenly across 4 table groups, and the story follows just one table's share from here. That table then trades with another class in a way that brings their marbles to 9 times what they held. A special event afterward brings their total to 3 times what it had grown to. A final contribution from a parent volunteer adds 6 more marbles to the table's collection. How many marbles does that table have now?
w10_T4_000246: A youth soccer team has sold 96 tickets to its championship game by Monday. By Tuesday, 47 more tickets are sold at school. A weekend promotion push brings the ticket count to 6 times what it had reached. The stadium itself seats 5,000 people total, though that number has nothing to do with how many tickets this particular team has sold. On the day of the game, 284 tickets are refunded after the event is postponed by rain. Once the game is rescheduled, 262 more tickets are refunded to fans who can no longer attend the new date. How many tickets does the team still have sold for the game?
